$comment: Host protocol and event payloads (fleet-stack L3 stage 1). Source for go/coordinator and app types; see contracts/README.md for the supported keyword subset.

routes.$comment: Every host route (POST, host-secret auth): its request and reply $defs (no reply: not described here), long (no surrounding transaction) and decode (checked: required keys and Validate, unknown keys refused when the request is closed; plain: decoded only). go/gen writes contract.Route<Name> descriptors; the coordinator registers each with hostRoute, the executor sends through them.

/api/hosts/poll.$comment: older hosts omit required fields (gitConnections); the open parts (stores, update) are also read as sent

/api/hosts/events.$comment: each event's identity is read from the batch as sent

/api/hosts/artifacts/list.$comment: answers HostArtifactListReply with the full artifact rows

ProjectArguments.$comment: Native tool arguments are forwarded unchanged to the owning project operation validator.

models.$comment: Models the vendor CLI on this host offers for this binding (probed at inspection). Absent: not probed (an older executor or a failed probe), never read as an empty list.

AccountLoginPrompt.$comment: A login the owner started on this host (inspection mode login): the vendor CLI's sign-in link and code as it printed them, for the owner to open; the CLI keeps waiting on the host until the sign-in completes or 15 minutes pass. Fleet never sees the password; the code is the CLI's one-time device code.

state.$comment: waiting (link shown, CLI waiting), signed-in (the CLI ended without an error), failed

text.$comment: The CLI's last lines, at most 500 characters, without terminal escapes.

forgeLogins.$comment: the forge logins this host checked from its forge store (forge_login.go): provider, forge host, whether its CLI answered as a user; the publishing capabilities follow from them, and System › Access shows a missing one

projectRoots.$comment: always sent; an empty list clears the host's roots

harnessVersions.$comment: observations for release-managed executables, absent on older hosts

toolVersions.$comment: host tools (go/harnessrelease Tools: node, pnpm, gh, glab): with tool pins on, the pinned version and the release-managed executable's; off, the version on the executor's PATH with no expected one. Absent on older hosts

gitConnections.$comment: names of the git connections this host holds (a key under FLEET_CONNECTIONS_DIR); names only, never key bytes or paths. Absent: unknown, dispatch does not skip on it. Required so an empty list is sent; an older host omits it, which the coordinator reads as unknown

activeExecutions.$comment: execution ids currently open on this host or holding a queued status receipt in its outbox; omitted by older hosts

load.$comment: latest host load, CPU count and memory readings sampled by the executor; omitted by older hosts

drain.$comment: the executor's drain for a pending update (docs/designs/fleet-self-update.md, Executor drain); absent when no update is pending or on older hosts

utcOffsetMinutes.$comment: the host's current offset from UTC in minutes, for its daily update window (docs/designs/fleet-host-updates.md section 7); absent on older hosts, read as UTC

diagnosis.$comment: the executor's report for host_diagnose, sent once after a poll reply with diagnose true; absent otherwise and on older hosts

HostDiagnosis.$comment: What a person used to read on the host (docs/designs/fleet-system-management.md#hosts, host_diagnose): built by the executor (diagnose.go), credentials redacted.

at.$comment: when the executor built it, ms

startedAt.$comment: when this executor process started, ms

logPath.$comment: the log file the tail is from

logTail.$comment: the last lines of the executor log, oldest first, each with its UTC time

outboxFailed.$comment: the newest outbox rows the coordinator refused (journal outbox_failed), newest first

transfersFailed.$comment: artifact transfers that failed in the last day, newest first

commands.$comment: commands in the journal that are not settled, oldest first

oldestAt.$comment: the oldest queued row's time, ms; absent when empty or unknown

target.$comment: the release the executor drains for

since.$comment: RFC 3339 UTC time the drain began

fenced.$comment: true: the executor admits no new start; false: the drain window passed with work still running, so starts are admitted again until reopenAt and the update waits for an idle moment

reopenAt.$comment: RFC 3339 UTC time the executor fences again; set while fenced is false

waitsFor.$comment: what still holds the drain, in words ("2 runs", "receipts to deliver"); empty: drained, the update installs on fleet-update's next run

tmpUsed.$comment: /tmp bytes used when it is tmpfs (Linux)

top.$comment: the host's top memory consumers, resident plus swapped bytes, largest first (docs/designs/fleet-host-cleanup.md#5-readings)

command.$comment: program base name, no arguments or paths

fleet.$comment: carries a run marker or is a Fleet program

expected.$comment: the release's pin; absent while tool pins are off

observed.$comment: x.y.z from <tool> --version; null when missing or unreadable

UpdateResult.$comment: last of the host's update-state.json, written by fleet-update

target.$comment: the coordinator's newest release version with a healthy marker; null offers no update

autoUpdate.$comment: the polling host's autoUpdate: on, off, or an RFC 3339 UTC hold-until time

diagnose.$comment: true when host_diagnose asked for a report since the host's latest one: the executor sends PollRequest.diagnosis in its next poll

Command.$comment: One command of a poll reply, by kind (CommandKind). Every member has the same envelope (id, kind, executionId, sessionId, hostId, traceparent, run) and its kind's payload; an executor keeps a kind it does not know as unknown and fails it.

traceparent.$comment: the validated W3C parent of this durable command; absent on older coordinators

InputCommand.$comment: kind input: the next turn of a running session

traceparent.$comment: the validated W3C parent of this durable command; absent on older coordinators

SteerCommand.$comment: kind steer: text into the running turn

traceparent.$comment: the validated W3C parent of this durable command; absent on older coordinators
the validated W3C parent of this durable command; absent on older coordinators
the validated W3C parent of this durable command; absent on older coordinators

ReadinessCommand.$comment: kind readiness: the project's readiness checks

traceparent.$comment: the validated W3C parent of this durable command; absent on older coordinators

BaseUpdatedCommand.$comment: kind base-updated: sync the checkout to its new base

traceparent.$comment: the validated W3C parent of this durable command; absent on older coordinators

TeardownCommand.$comment: kind teardown: the session's worktree teardown

traceparent.$comment: the validated W3C parent of this durable command; absent on older coordinators

ArtifactCopyCommand.$comment: kind artifact-copy: copy an artifact into a store

traceparent.$comment: the validated W3C parent of this durable command; absent on older coordinators

ArtifactVerifyCommand.$comment: kind artifact-verify: verify a store copy

traceparent.$comment: the validated W3C parent of this durable command; absent on older coordinators

AccountInspectCommand.$comment: kind account-inspect: inspect a native account

traceparent.$comment: the validated W3C parent of this durable command; absent on older coordinators

ConnectionRemoveCommand.$comment: kind connection-remove: delete a connection's key

traceparent.$comment: the validated W3C parent of this durable command; absent on older coordinators

PublishingCommand.$comment: kind publishing: execute a coordinator-dispatched publishing operation on a host holding the forge store

Capability.$comment: A capability a host reports in its poll (PollRequest.capabilities, strings so older and newer names pass). Besides these: tool:<name> (a coding tool on PATH, tool:browser), forge:<owner>/<repo> (a forge connection), ffmpeg:<version>. contract.MissingCapability is the one gate on them.

Receipt.$comment: Execution status receipt; delegation and account envelopes have their own generated types.

type.$comment: a FleetEventType, or the native harness record type (open)

data.$comment: EventData for harness records; a Fleet type's own data def (FleetEventType) otherwise. Raw, so native records keep every field.

EventData.$comment: Harness events keep their native record and add fleetNormalized; item is set on item.completed. Other kinds carry their own fields (open).

Item.$comment: A completed native item (codex), agentMessage renamed agent_message.

Normalized.$comment: harness::project and Blocks::project output; only the fields the coordinator and app read are named.

agentConfig.$comment: agent profile; validated by the profile contract

attachments.$comment: Message attachments, each also in inputs at its path under FLEET_INPUT_DIR; the executor lists them in the turn text and passes images natively where the harness supports it

readOnly.$comment: The session was started read-only (a preset's access read): codex runs in its read-only sandbox, claude gets only Read, Glob and Grep (and the Skill and web tools the run grants), antigravity and acp run in plan mode (an agent without one refuses the start). Absent or false: the grant of the profile.

branch.$comment: false: the session worktree is detached at its base, so no session branch is created. Absent or true: branch <prefix>/<session>.

StartPayload.$comment: start and input. Named fields; lane A replaces the coordinator's merge of a free payload over them.

branch.$comment: teardown: false when the session started without a branch (a detached worktree); then commits the checkout's own branches hold are not its unpushed work.

deleteBranch.$comment: teardown only: the work was delivered (its task accepted), so the local branch is deleted with git branch -D

ProjectPayload.$comment: readiness, base-updated and teardown: the project context plus kind-specific fields

ProjectContext.$comment: The project a command carries as payload.project: the project's frozen settings (docs/configuration.md, coordinator projectSettings) plus profileIds. The payload types keep it an open object; the executor decodes it as this type once per command.

contextSources.$comment: immutable repository-rule references, validated by contract.ContextSources; absent or null: none

connection.$comment: the git connection (an SSH key under FLEET_CONNECTIONS_DIR); absent: host ssh

repo.$comment: a repos id; absent: the project's first repo

ProjectIdentity.$comment: git author and committer; null: none

linkPaths.$comment: relative paths linked into the worktree; an item that is not a string is skipped

keepWhen.$comment: absent: uncommitted, unpushed, teardown-failed; an item that is not a string is skipped

ProjectDevEnvironment.$comment: The project's dev environment (docs/configuration.md#project-environment): a rootless Podman pod outside the agent sandbox, reached through the project-env MCP tools. Needs execution.tools podman.

image.$comment: Image of the main container, when build is absent.

build.$comment: Containerfile path relative to the worktree root; the image is built from the worktree and cached by the file's hash.

workdir.$comment: Where the worktree is mounted in the main container; default /workspace.

setup.$comment: Shell command run once in the main container after the pod starts (dependencies, schema).

ProjectDevService.$comment: A side container of the pod; its name resolves to 127.0.0.1 in every container of the pod.

ArtifactTransferPayload.$comment: artifact-copy and artifact-verify; the transfer worker reads the rest

FleetEventType.$comment: Event types the executor itself originates. Native harness records keep their own open type. Readers log an unknown type as a problem, never fail (hosts may run another release during self-update).

stderrTail.$comment: the last 2000 bytes of the harness stderr when it exited non-zero (the coordinator records its last line as the execution problem)

hostId.$comment: probe only: the host that read it

LimitReading.$comment: fleet-people-access.md section 8: one reading per provider window

ArtifactReserveRequest.$comment: POST /api/hosts/artifacts/reserve: an upload's artifact row; the reply names its state and store.

ArtifactPartsRequest.$comment: POST /api/hosts/artifacts/parts: presigned URLs for these part numbers.

ArtifactCommitRequest.$comment: POST /api/hosts/artifacts/commit: the uploaded parts with their etags.

ArtifactVerifiedRequest.$comment: POST /api/hosts/artifacts/verified: the digest a store's host read back.

ArtifactLeaseRequest.$comment: POST /api/hosts/artifacts/renew: the lease of a running transfer.

executionId.$comment: the execution whose upload failed; with name, a refused reservation (no artifact row) is recorded on it (refusedArtifacts) instead of answering 404. Absent from older hosts

name.$comment: the output name the upload had

refused.$comment: true when the coordinator refused the reservation (a 4xx answer to reserve): the bytes were refused on purpose, so the execution fails

ArtifactFailedRequest.$comment: POST /api/hosts/artifacts/failed: a transfer that cannot finish.

ArtifactDeclareRequest.$comment: POST /api/hosts/artifacts/declare: a required artifact the execution will upload.

commandId.$comment: a pending tool command (delivery-step, artifact-copy, artifact-verify) that names the artifact

HostArtifactGetRequest.$comment: executionId (the reader's execution) or commandId (its open tool command) names why this host may read

HostArtifactListRequest.$comment: POST /api/hosts/artifacts/list: the artifacts the execution may read, newest first, in pages of 50 (reply {artifacts, nextCursor?}).

StoreRegistration.$comment: A store a host serves; the keys go to the coordinator's secret directory, never to rows.

AgentToolsRequest.$comment: POST /api/hosts/agent-tools: one MCP JSON-RPC request of a native agent (request stays the raw JSON-RPC frame).

HostArtifactListFilter.$comment: Optional narrowing of /api/hosts/artifacts/list. Without executionId or taskId it lists the execution's project (an execution without a project: only itself); the executor sends its own executionId unless the agent asked for the project.

StoreReport.$comment: one store's reachability and capacity, sent with each poll

ProjectScriptResult.$comment: data of a setup event, and the teardown script inside Teardown; output is the last 4000 bytes

TranscriptText.$comment: a text block of fleetNormalized.blocks (kind text); the app's Block (ops) adds key and the thread fields

TranscriptReasoning.$comment: a reasoning block of fleetNormalized.blocks (kind reasoning)

TranscriptTool.$comment: a tool block of fleetNormalized.blocks (kind tool); input and output are the native values

SpanBatchRequest.$comment: POST /api/hosts/spans (docs/designs/fleet-telemetry.md section 4): spans of an executor or gateway. Each item is one span row with the ClickHouse column names (go/obs Span); a row naming another host_id, or an execution_id not on this host, is skipped. batchId makes a retried batch idempotent.

ArtifactReserveReply.$comment: state pending (upload the parts to storeId), stored (nothing to upload) or the state of an earlier reservation of the same id

ArtifactVerify.$comment: a presigned read of the staged object for the store host to hash

ArtifactStateReply.$comment: commit, verified, renew and failed: the artifact or copy state; commit answers verifying with verify when the writer is the store host

nextCursor.$comment: present while older artifacts remain: the filter cursor of the next page

ReceiptReply.$comment: a status receipt; the account and project routes answer their operation's record

CheckoutSync.$comment: data of a checkout.synced or sync-failed event

ConnectionRemovePayload.$comment: Delete <FLEET_CONNECTIONS_DIR>/<connection> (its deploy key) on the host; sent when the last live project using the connection is archived.

CommandRun.$comment: Coordinator-owned observation identity only; no credentials or permission grants.

ForgeReviewRequest.$comment: Verify auditable review evidence and permission before posting exact-SHA code-review status.

PublishingCommandPayload.$comment: Payload for kind=publishing host commands dispatched by publishing_* operations.

PublishingHostRecord.$comment: Host report of a confirmed publishing observation or command result.
